units.source_text: 尽管远离了驹子，岛村还不时惦念着她，

en.t: Even when he was far from Komako, Shimamura still thought of her from time to time,

units.source_text: 可一旦来到她身边，也许是完全放下了心，或是与她的肉体过分亲近的缘故，

en.t: but once he came to her side, perhaps because he was completely at ease, or because he had grown too intimate with her body,

units.source_text: 总是觉得对肌肤的依恋和对山峦的憧憬这种相思之情，如同一个梦境。

en.t: he always felt that this longing, this attachment to the warmth of skin and yearning for the mountains, was like a dream.

units.source_text: 这大概也是由于昨晚驹子在这里过夜刚刚回去的缘故吧。

en.t: This was probably also because Komako had only just gone back after spending the night here last night.

units.source_text: 但是，在寂静中独自呆坐，

en.t: But sitting alone in the stillness,

units.source_text: 只好期待着驹子会不邀自来，此外别无他法。

en.t: he could do nothing but hope that Komako would come on her own without being called.

units.source_text: 听着徒步旅行的女学生天真活泼的嬉戏打闹声，

en.t: Listening to the innocent, lively laughter and commotion of the schoolgirls on their hike,

units.source_text: 岛村不知不觉间感到昏昏欲睡，于是便早早入眠了。

en.t: Shimamura grew drowsy without realizing it, and so he went to sleep early.
